_comment: Canonical King Intelligence config keys with safe CLIENT defaults. The migration step in /king-intelligence:update merges any ABSENT or BLANK key into the client's references/king-intelligence-config.md additively, and NEVER changes a value the client already set. Section + key order here is the order new keys/sections get written. The script paths are repo-relative (.claude/scripts/...): the migration COPIES the maintenance scripts there from the plugin, and since 9/14/26 scripts/local-scripts.mjs re-levels them with the NEWEST installed toolkit at EVERY session start (from auto-update.mjs) and on /king-intelligence:update, so the copies can no longer fall behind the plugin (a skill's shell call does not expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, which is why a copy exists at all). end-session now resolves the newest toolkit itself first and treats these keys as fallbacks.
